sentences.text: FDA first posted the dexamethasone sodium phosphate shortage on 2019-02-08 and it remains Current as of 2026-10-21.
The shortage lists Eugia US LLC, Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., Mylan Institutional, and Somerset Therapeutics LLC as affected companies.
FDA inspection 1074573 at Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited ended 2018-12-14 and was classified VAI, 56 days before the shortage posting.
A later inspection 1228546 at the same plant ended 2024-02-02 and was classified OAI, and inspection 1301166 ended 2026-02-06 also OAI.
FDA issued a Warning Letter to Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited on 2024-08-15.

Corvale East has 5.5 days of 1 mg tablets on hand and Corvale General has 25.9 days; the rule‑ranked option is to transfer 56 tablets from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would give Corvale East 14 days and leave Corvale General with 17 days.
Check wholesalers for inventory as noted in FDA's related information for the Eugia US LLC listing.
